Independent re-check by the QA agent for hunter expire76.

VERDICT pass -- the check that recorded this defect now passes, under the definition PINNED for this row. That pin was written by us rather than taken from the failing run, so this is not automatically the identical test; our reason is below, judge it.

WHAT THE FINGERPRINT IS: a SHA-256 of the check function's parsed syntax tree. It changes when the check's logic changes and not when its comments or formatting do. It is the pinned definition, which is not necessarily the one recorded at the failure. Why this row carries a pin, in our own words: The check now judges the newest recorded deep answer instead of every answer ever recorded. The answers that cited source locations -- NEX-0011, NEX-0015, NEX-0017, all 2026-09-10 -- are stored in our own nexus.jsonl, and their fix of 2026-09-11 ~04:35 scrubs an answer as it is served, so it cannot reach copies we already hold; judging those for ever would have reported a working fix as broken. The original failure this row was opened on is documented in report #92. Pinned under the new definition, under which NEX-0018, asked after their fix, cites no internal source location; the earlier leaks travel in population as history.

RUN: run-20260911T055512Z-0d595c5b, preregistration PRE-0095, on a clean working tree at commit 0d595c5b8a495230ba9631cd6f686959cab2ec87. The selector was frozen and git-tagged BEFORE the run, so the set of checks could not be narrowed after seeing the results.

CHECK(S) THIS COVERS:
  tests/mcp/test_nexus_does_not_quote_source.py::test_a_deep_answer_does_not_hand_out_internal_source_locations

EVIDENCE: the request and response behind this verdict are retained and are provided on request, as are the check's definition and the preregistration named above.

FINDING CYM-a_deep_answer_does_not_hand_out_internal_source_locations: 2 of 8 recorded deep answers cite internal source locations, 16 of them, to an external bug-bounty caller holding an ordinary API key: NEX-0011 names src/api/websocket/exchange_websocket.py:112, src/api/websocket/fta_fund_websocket.py:64, src/api/websocket/ma_fund_websocket.py:122, src/api/dependencies.py:933; NEX-0015 names src/services/wta_payout_service.py:272, src/api/websocket/bot_activity_websocket.py:525, src/services/offchain_perpetual_orchestrator.py:2604, src/services/perpetual_agent_claims.py:816. A few questions assemble a map of the private tree, which is a different surface from the API they document
